svg.text: How SIEVER Works in Five Workspaces: Five Questions, the Same Pages

Opened with SIEVER::run_app(): the pages grouped by the question each answers (sixteen pages, with Scoring and Norms inside Reliability); one shared study record keeps data, decisions and results together.
0. HOW TO OPEN IT: SIEVER runs on your computer, in your browser (R 4.1 or later)
# DMAR, its engine, comes from CRAN with it
# or the archive of a release, from GitHub,
# an optional feature names what it needs,
# for example haven for an SPSS file
?SIEVER # the help page, with this map
# options(), set before run_app(); each has a default

g.text: 1. THE ARRANGEMENT, opened with SIEVER::run_app(): five workspaces, each answering one question; its pages are its sub-tabs
What are the items and the data,
and are they ready to analyze?
scree, PA, VSS, fit by k
searches in their own R process, Cancel
omega with CI, H, factor scores,
What do the scores relate to, and do they mean
the same thing across groups and samples?
split, holdout of the CFA page's
the methods draft, the session script
Every page is in exactly one workspace (a test pins it); a dashed box is optional; Ingest and Screening come first; a known structure goes from Study to CFA directly.
2. THE SHARED STATE (sieve_new_state): one reactiveValues store read by every page
one row per item: item, label, construct, facet,
items are excluded, never destroyed; labels are not analytic
$items on the rows in the analysis
removed and reserved respondents are kept
confirmed; the estimator and the sampling
design, both declared on Ingest, step 4;
the analytic ledger key and the data key say
exactly what a result was computed from,
so an edit marks every dependent result as from before
3. THE SHARED SERVICES every analysis page goes through
ordered indicators; every fit returns a status:
ok, inadmissible, not identified, not converged
Load and Confirm fit nothing. A first
result runs on its own page only when
estimated at two seconds or less; otherwise
its button states the wait. Inclusion changes
refit results already requested. Long searches
run in their own R process and can be canceled.
The fit store and the basis
the identical model on identical data, fit on
one page, reused on another by exact identity;
mixed) per item pool, shared by four pages
the same guide on every page (what is needed,
which results are current); results first:
status line, a method line read from the held
result, the result, then the explanation
every result's panel shows the recorded calls,
copies them, or downloads the analysis as a
bundle (code, README, the input view when
shared); opening a panel runs nothing
Engines in the house order: DMAR first, then lavaan, then psych; psychonetrics, qgraph and igraph for Network only. Pages share the same study and analysis records.
Every page: the same gate (data loaded, study confirmed), the same estimator rule and sampling declaration, the same identification (factor variances fixed at 1), full precision stored
and rounded only on display, a confidence interval wherever the method supports one, and an explanation beside the result with the detail and citations one click away.
Fit indices are DMAR's: one SRMR, of the covariance residuals alone, on every page, and every RMSEA interval at 90 percent unless options(sieve.rmsea_conf_level) says otherwise.
4. THE RECORDS every run writes (nothing is reported that was not run)
one record per run: specification, input revision, stored
results at full precision, status, n used, engine identities
The code log and the replay store
every consequential action as an annotated, runnable step
of R; one content-addressed copy of each input it ran on
a verified citation behind each method (DOI checked),
so a report cites only what ran
5. WHAT COMES OUT: the Report workspace (Reproducible Code), the project file, the exports, the API
Report saved analyses (chosen in the list or the catalog; runs
nothing), the optional methods draft, the session script
replay store; a reopened project waits on every page
the data file and its specification, which re-enter
Ingest; the moments of the included items
sieve_analyze() and the exported sieve_* services run
the same specifications and engines without the interface
a saved project reopens through Ingest, in Study
